environment.description: Rails 7.0 application deployed on EC2 instances behind an NLB. Split.io SDK configured with API key pointing to Split Cloud. The feature flag 'archive-extraction-v2' is set to 'off' for all users in the Split dashboard (rollout at 0%). The application runs as www-data user with write access to the public/ directory tree. No additional path filtering or filesystem sandboxing is applied.
